test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e091ef63f4e20c1a51d303f64da351dd7d6ecde623c3fceb04e836cf12151575.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For 'L' element : Shifting one position backward and forward subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/540dcc85b6d494e5a53f87ce383fefb2dca4602ced9b83349d76ccab76411cd5.png] 

2) For top corner and center corner elements : 

 
• Alternately left top corner interchanged positions with right center corner element starting with first box.
 
• Alternately right top corner interchanged positions with left center corner element starting with first box.
 
• Alternately left center corner elements shifts to bottom left corner position starting with second box.
 
• Alternately right center corner elements shifts to top right corner position starting with second box. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03428aed17dad02bf785378d3ba06bac4eeb164d20e2c62bb1afc8976de7401a.png] 

3) For second element from left center corner and bottom elements : 

 
• Alternately second element from left center corner shifts to bottom left corner position starting with first box.
 
• Alternately bottom left corner element shifts to bottom right corner position starting with first box.
 
• Bottom right corners elements are replaced by new elements i.e [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1492a3a1902167993ab59b213395b9d6c1b0b273ef869907b0533f3cd7d52152.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a7a706b64e8bbaecfeee5f32fe54573b3ce0e7edf0544f590b2c58ab4418e9b.png] 

4) For top corner and second element from right center corner elements : 

 
• Alternately left top corner shifts to the left center corner position starting with second box.
 
• Alternately right top corner shifts to the second positions from left center corner starting with second box.
 
• Alternately second element from right center corner shifts to right center corner position starting with second box.

 

Final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74693697e48a5fcb1ee44289f9f683e349b18e4c41f8abf3944d5a2a16085997.png] 

Hence, ‘Option - (2)’ is the correct answer.
